title: Three Raccoons and a Robot
tagline: They used to live in his pants. Now they live in his house.
description: Rook is a hardworking robot with a simple dream: a peaceful home, an orderly life, and perhaps five uninterrupted minutes to enjoy his coffee. Unfortunately, he shares his home with Gerald, Arthur, and Pickles, three raccoon brothers whose combined talents include questionable entrepreneurship, financial misconduct, cannoli consumption, and an almost supernatural ability to make everything Rook's problem. Gerald wants to run the household like a corporation. Arthur refuses to wear pants. Pickles owes money to a rubber duck. And Rook? He's desperately trying to keep everyone out of prison. From disastrous business ventures to spectacular domestic arguments, Three Raccoons and a Robot proves that family isn't always something you're born into. Sometimes it's three raccoons who move into your trousers and refuse to leave.

title: The Bellweather Hotel
tagline: Everyone checks in with a secret. Not everyone checks out with it.
description: 1958. Behind the gleaming marble, glittering chandeliers, and impeccable service of the Bellweather Hotel, every guest has something to hide. Its formidable general manager, Beatrice Bellweather (Lucy), has spent fifteen years protecting the hotel's reputation and keeping its secrets. But when a mysterious figure appears on the upper balcony, the past threatens to unravel everything she has built. As blackmail, forbidden romances, and dangerous loyalties collide, Beatrice must decide which secrets are worth keeping and what she's willing to sacrifice to protect the Bellweather.

title: A Pinch of Dragon
tagline: Good food. Warm hospitality. Occasionally excessive heat.
description: Welcome to Daisy Bell's kitchen, where every guest is family, every recipe comes with a story, and the oven is occasionally unnecessary. Join Daisy, the dragon behind one of Gnomeville's beloved bed-and-breakfasts, as she shares hearty breakfasts, comforting suppers, decadent desserts, and the secrets of exceptional hospitality. With occasional visits from her wife, attorney Shirley Bell, and their son Simon, there's always something simmering at the Bell household. Pull up a chair. There's always room for one more.

title: Home for the Hollandaise
cast: Margaux de Vigne as Clara Maplewood; Theodore “Theo” Brookstone as the hometown carpenter
tagline: Sometimes the recipe for happiness starts with coming home.
description: After twelve years away, city event planner Clara Maplewood returns to settle her late grandmother's estate. With just seven days to save the family inn and the town Thanksgiving feast, she finds unexpected help and romance with a hometown carpenter. Starring Margaux de Vigne and Theodore “Theo” Brookstone. The original promotional poster featured Milo, who was replaced amid an ongoing investigation; allegations are not convictions. See WikiGnome for the production history.

title: Breaker
tagline: Bigger. Quieter. Gnomier.
description: He doesn't carry a badge. He doesn't answer to anyone. And he doesn't ask twice. Batista has spent years traveling between towns, taking odd jobs, avoiding unnecessary conversation, and occasionally dismantling criminal enterprises with a baseball bat. But when a seemingly routine delivery of municipal equipment disappears, Batista finds himself caught between a powerful salvage syndicate, a suspiciously well-funded beautification committee, and an entire town whose official records insist the missing shipment never existed. As witnesses change their stories and evidence vanishes from locked government offices, Batista discovers that someone has been quietly buying up entire neighborhoods through a network of fraudulent property claims. Unfortunately for them, Batista has never been particularly impressed by paperwork. The conspirators have money, influence, and an army of hired muscle. Batista has a baseball bat. Some men bend the rules. Batista breaks them.

title: Feely
tagline: She notices everything.
description: She notices everything. Feely makes her living solving problems other people insist don't exist. Missing valuables, impossible alibis, suspicious transactions: if something doesn't add up, she finds the discrepancy. When a routine investigation into a forged insurance claim uncovers a series of identical photographs taken years apart, Feely follows the trail into an elaborate scheme involving counterfeit antiques, fabricated histories, and a private auction house that appears to be selling objects before they've even been stolen. Every clue points toward a different suspect. Every suspect has an airtight alibi. And the closer Feely gets to the truth, the more carefully someone begins watching her. Her former associate Batista offers to help. She declines. He offers again. She changes her phone number. But when the investigation threatens to expose a criminal network operating across several towns, Feely discovers that even the smallest detail can bring down the largest operation. Some people look for trouble. Feely sees it coming.

title: The Gnomedock Saints
tagline: Brothers. Gnomes. Questionable morals.
description: In Gnomeville, every criminal enterprise has a business license, every suspicious transaction has a receipt, and every neighborhood dispute eventually becomes somebody else's problem. Zeus and Batista have spent years protecting the interests of the GnomeLords, a notoriously tight-knit organization whose activities occupy the increasingly blurry territory between community service and organized crime. But when a routine collection reveals that someone has been secretly diverting the syndicate's money into a mysterious municipal redevelopment project, the two enforcers discover an operation far bigger than anything they've encountered. Their only lead is Hardrock, a suspiciously cheerful gnome with an encyclopedic knowledge of local finances and an alarming number of acquaintances who have recently disappeared. As rival factions mobilize, alliances collapse, and the municipal accounting department refuses to cooperate without Form 47-B, Zeus and Batista embark on a campaign to uncover who's really running Gnomeville. Justice is coming. Whether it's properly authorized remains unclear.
